refined_question: Let W be a simply connected open subset of the complex plane whose boundary in the Riemann sphere contains at least two points, and let φ: W → D be any conformal bijection of W onto the open unit disk D. Determine whether, for every real exponent p satisfying 4/3 < p < 4, the pth power of the derivative of φ is integrable over W with respect to area measure; that is, whether ∫_W |φ′(z)|^p dx dy < ∞ holds for all such p, and whether this integrability fails for p ≤ 4/3 or p ≥ 4.
